notes: Pronoun Palace visual repair; original hero, purple cabinet, icon atlas and arena preserved.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Create ONE game weapon sprite: an ordinary RED OFFICE PAPER CUTTER / retractable utility knife. Square canvas, truly transparent alpha background. Entire single object isolated, generous 14% clear margin on all sides, hilt at lower left and blade tip at upper right, 45-degree diagonal. This is a small flat icon AND a sprite held by the hero; make recognizable at 32 px.
Input images: Image 1 actors.png is the authoritative simple pixel cartoon character style; image 2 icons.png authoritative thick black pixel outline and bold readable shapes; image 3 screenshot is authoritative overall humorous low-detail flat pixel art aesthetic. Copy only style, not subjects, background or glows.
Make a very simple squat red utility-knife body with ONE black slider block, dark butt cap, short pale gray trapezoid blade. Thick completely BLACK stair-step pixel contour about 2 logical pixels wide. Draw on an obvious coarse logical 64x64 pixel grid, crisp right angle stair-step edges, slightly crooked humorous shape. Each material uses ONLY TWO LARGE FLAT COLOR SHAPES: red/dark red body, gray/offwhite blade, black slider. At most one straight black blade segment mark. No ribs, screws, holes, scratches, grain, noise, dithering, speckles, realistic shading, gradients, lighting, highlights, antialiasing, texture, metallic rendering, soft shadows, cast shadows, ambient halo, glow or scenic background. No hands, no holder, no text or label. TRUE RGBA transparency around the object; never paint a checkerboard. The graphic must be as simple and flat as the hero's red blade in actors.png, never a detailed painted item.

Background correction prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Edit image 1: keep the red utility knife, its pixelated silhouette, proportions, flat colors and black outline exactly unchanged. Remove the entire background around the knife completely. The result MUST be a transparent PNG with a real alpha channel, not an RGB image. Every background pixel must have alpha=0. Opaque object only, no drop shadows. Image 2 and image 3 are canonical style references only. Produce a single square image.
assets.anchor_note: Grip center on lower red body; tip at upper-right blade end.
